FINDINGS: 6 open (1 critical, 1 high, 1 medium, 3 low), 2 informational, 0 accepted
Ranked by severity in your context, among what scheck checked. Areas not checked may hold worse
problems than anything here.
To accept a risk instead of fixing it, see IF YOU DECIDE NOT TO FIX A FINDING after the findings.

1  critical  A secret-shaped credential is published in the response (example.com)
   [web.secret_in_response]
   Subject       GitHub token in https://example.com/ (secret_location
                 github-token:https://example.com/)
   Observed      page1 (07:12, as anonymous): One GitHub token match was removed from the captured
                 response before reporting
   Severity      critical
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the response or connection observed.
   Not checked   Credential validity was not tested
   Fix           Revoke the credential at its provider first, then remove it from the response and
                 review its use.

2  high  A DKIM RSA key is shorter than 1024 bits (example.com) [email.dkim_key_breakable]
   Subject       selector google (google-workspace) on example.com (dkim_selector
                 google._domainkey.example.com)
   Observed      dkim1 (07:12, as anonymous): DKIM at google._domainkey.example.com; RSA modulus 512
                 bits
   Severity      high
   Why here      You declared selector google for google-workspace.
   Not checked   Whether this selector signs current mail and whether that mail aligns were not
                 assessed
   Fix           Rotate to a 2048-bit RSA key at your sender, publish its new selector, verify
                 delivery, then retire the old key.

3  medium  The origin serves plain HTTP instead of redirecting to HTTPS (example.com)
   [web.plaintext_http]
   Subject       http://example.com (origin http://example.com)
   Observed      http1 (07:12, as anonymous): HTTP serves a page containing a password input
   Severity      medium: base low, +1 attribute password form (http1: HTTP serves a page containing
                 a password input)
   Why here      The HTTP page contains a password input, so it ranks one step higher.
   Fix           Redirect HTTP entry points to HTTPS, or close port 80.

4  low  An observed session cookie lacks Secure or HttpOnly (example.com) [web.session_cookie_flags]
   Subject       https://example.com (origin https://example.com)
   Observed      page1 (07:12, as anonymous): Session cookie lacks HttpOnly
   Severity      low
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the response or connection observed.
   Fix           Set Secure and HttpOnly on session cookies, and serve their application over HTTPS.

5  low  DMARC publishes a partial percentage for legacy receivers (example.com)
   [email.dmarc_partial]
   Subject       example.com (declared sending: google-workspace) (mail_domain example.com)
   Observed      dmarc1 (07:12, as anonymous): DMARC p=reject; legacy pct=25; test mode=false
   Severity      low
   Why here      You listed google-workspace as sending for example.com. DNS does not show whether
                 it sends current mail.
   Not checked   Actual receiver enforcement and message alignment were not assessed
   Fix           Verify each legitimate sender in DMARC reports, then remove pct or set it to 100.

6  low  SPF includes a service absent from the declared senders (example.com)
   [email.spf_undeclared_sender]
   Subject       SPF include:sendgrid.net on example.com (spf_mechanism
                 example.com/include:sendgrid.net)
   Observed      spf1 (07:12, as anonymous): SPF includes senders through include:sendgrid.net maps
                 to sendgrid, absent from declared senders
   Observed      spf2 (07:12, as anonymous): SPF includes senders through include:sendgrid.net maps
                 to sendgrid, absent from declared senders
   Severity      low
   Why here      You listed google-workspace as sending for example.com.
   Fix           Confirm who owns and uses this sending service. Add it to mail.senders if intended;
                 otherwise remove its include after checking mail delivery.

Informational
   The certificate expires within 14 days (example.com) [tls.certificate_expiring]
   The URL reveals a software version (example.com) [web.version_disclosed]: base low, lowered: you
     declared this URL exposed on purpose: public build information
